name: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS)
description: A large multilingual corpus suitable for speech research derived from read audiobooks from LibriVox, consisting of 8 languages with about 44.5K hours of English and a total of about 6K hours for other languages.
creator: Vineel Pratap, Qiantong Xu, Anuroop Sriram, Gabriel Synnaeve, Ronan Collobert (Facebook AI Research)
citeAs: Vineel Pratap et al. (2020). MLS: A Large-Scale Multilingual Dataset for Speech Research.
rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by downloading audiobooks from LibriVox, segmenting the audio files, generating pseudo-labels, and retrieving original transcripts by matching pseudo-labels to available book transcripts.
rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator
rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data consists of audiobooks from LibriVox and text sources from Project Gutenberg and other domains.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Audio files were downsampled from 48kHz to 16kHz, segmented into 10-20 second segments, and text data was normalized to remove unwanted characters and format inconsistencies.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human transcribers were employed to listen to the audio files and correct transcripts for clear and obvious errors.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset aims to promote open research in large-scale training of ASR systems and multilingual ASR.
rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may not cover all languages equally and may have limitations in the quality of transcripts due to the diversity of text sources.
rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for training, testing, and validating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems and for Text-to-Speech (TTS) research.
